It gives no data, analysis, or source for either claim.","evidence_quote":"Late deliveries are the single biggest reason customers churn, and fixing them would save the business millions every year.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the churn analysis and the savings model behind these claims, or remove or soften them."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Customer contact use lacks a privacy review","detail":"Agents will phone customers, so the proposal uses customer phone numbers and contact details, which the policy treats as personal data. The Reviews section records only contact center staffing, with no privacy review covering purpose limitation and retention.","evidence_quote":"Operations agents phone customers whose orders are running late to explain the delay and offer a reschedule.","citations":["policy-compliance#customer-location-and-personal-data"],"recommendation":"Obtain and record a Privacy review (or DPIA) covering use of customer phone numbers and call data before launch."}]}
